name: Morin Brunaria
source:
Zella's uncle who takes part as the head of the council of Brunaria. Cold, strict and feared, she makes the others around her follow her instructions to the letter, with no care of other people's life.
Rumors says that every person who opposed or just angered her, ended banished from the kingdom.
